assumptions: Focal-length suggestions are full-frame equivalents until the camera format is confirmed.
point_of_view: Stay with the protagonist's incomplete perception.
contrast: Retain shadow detail while separating the subject from the environment.
texture: Use clean optics and let one story-motivated surface carry organic texture.
lens_strategy: Progress from compressed details to a restrained normal-wide view as geography becomes meaningful.
visual_motifs: rectilinear geometry yielding to one organic form
exceptions: Break central symmetry only when the protagonist makes the first voluntary choice.

rules.composition: Hold the protagonist on the environment's central axis.
rules.camera_height: Begin at the environment's functional height and rise only with the protagonist.
rules.dramatic_purpose: Make a later break in geometry register as agency.
